_doc: T-431 server-authored roost graph, extended by T-596 to the continent flight web (phase 1). Coords are world planar [x,y]; PlayerSessions derives terrain z at landing. Connections are directed hops with copper cost; author both directions explicitly. Every P1 build zone (continent-plan.md §1) has >=1 node and the capital (Highkeep) is the hub. Costs are tuned MONOTONIC to the real inter-node planar distance (nodes sit at their zone's real region origin per regions.json), so a longer hop always costs more. flight_speed is the >=x3-run data value from continent-plan.md §3 (tuned here); the travel-time audit reads it as the flight budget. Era crossings (Wold->Ashmoor->Greyrise) are modeled as long sky-lane hops in P1 — the shipped highkeep->ashmoor precedent — and become rift capstones in P2 (continent-plan.md §0/§3).
